name: Breezy
positioning: A mobile AI workspace built by a working agent, for agents — comps, notes and pipeline in one place.
description: Breezy is a mobile AI workspace for residential real estate agents and small brokerages. It generates client-ready comparable market analyses, takes automated notes during in-person conversations, updates a transaction pipeline from those notes, and surfaces nearby development potential through its UnderBuilt Radar module.
real_estate_use: An agent leaving a listing appointment used to type up notes from memory and build a comp sheet from scratch that evening; Breezy's assistant listens during the meeting, turns the conversation into structured notes, and produces a polished comparable-property analysis in seconds so the follow-up email can go out before the agent is back in the car. A brokerage admin gets the same activity rolled up across the team instead of chasing individual agents for pipeline updates.
features: Pipeline stage updates from captured notes
UnderBuilt Radar for nearby development potential

use_cases.job: Produce a client-ready comp sheet and follow-up notes right after a listing appointment
See team-wide agent activity and pipeline without manual reporting
